name: Cursed Undead
description: Ignores each wound on a roll of 6+.

name: Cursed Undead Boost
description: Ignores each wound on a roll of 5+.

name: Cursed Undead Boost Buff
description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12 inches, which gains Cursed Undead Boost for its next relevant roll.

name: Angelic Blessing
description: Ignores each wound on a roll of 6+. Ignores each wound from a spell on a roll of 4+ instead.

name: Angelic Blessing Boost
description: Ignores each wound from a spell on a roll of 2+.

name: Angelic Blessing Boost Buff
description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12 inches, which gains Angelic Blessing Boost for its next relevant roll.

name: Empyrean Spirit
description: Enemies shooting or charging this unit from over 9 inches away get -1 to hit.

name: Empyrean Spirit Boost
description: Enemies attacking this unit always get -1 to hit from Empyrean Spirit (not only from over 9 inches away).

name: Empyrean Spirit Boost Aura
description: This model and its unit gain Empyrean Spirit Boost.

name: Ossified
description: Hits on this unit from over 9 inches away count as AP reduced by 1, to a minimum of 0.

name: Ossified Boost
description: Hits on this unit always count as AP reduced by 1 from Ossified (not only from over 9 inches away).

name: Ossified Boost Aura
description: This model and its unit gain Ossified Boost.

name: Warden
description: Hits on this unit from over 9 inches away count as AP reduced by 1, to a minimum of 0.

name: Warden Boost
description: Hits on this unit always count as AP reduced by 1 from Warden (not only from over 9 inches away).

name: Warden Boost Aura
description: This model and its unit gain Warden Boost.

name: Bestial
description: The defender must re-roll unmodified Defense 6s.

name: Bestial Boost
description: If this model has Bestial, when it shoots or charges enemies over 9 inches away, enemies taking hits from it must re-roll successful unmodified defense results of 5-6. Save re-rolls compose by the widest band, so this states the full 5-6 rather than an increment.

name: Bestial Boost Aura
description: This model and its unit get Bestial Boost.

name: Lucky
description: Each unmodified 6 to hit scores an extra hit.

name: Lucky Boost
description: If this model has Lucky and shoots or charges enemies over 9 inches away, unmodified 5s or 6s to hit each score an extra hit (instead of only 6). The base rule already covers the 6s.

name: Lucky Boost Aura
description: This model and its unit gain Lucky Boost.

name: Royal Warrior
description: Each unmodified 6 to hit scores an extra hit.

name: Royal Warrior Boost
description: If this model has Royal Warrior, unmodified 5s or 6s to hit each score an extra hit (instead of only 6). The base rule already covers the 6s.

name: Royal Warrior Boost Aura
description: This model and its unit gain Royal Warrior Boost.

name: Great Sergeant
description: When this model attacks, unmodified results of 5-6 to hit each deal 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts for special rules).

name: Wave-Step
description: When this unit is activated, it may place all its models anywhere fully within D3 inches of their position.

name: Wave-Step Boost
description: If this model has Wave-Step, it may be placed within 2D3 inches instead of only D3 inches.

name: Wave-Step Boost Aura
description: This model and its unit gain Wave-Step Boost.

name: Royal Legion
description: Gets +4 inches range when shooting, and moves +2 inches on Charge actions.

name: Royal Legion Boost
description: If this model has Royal Legion, it gets +8 inches shooting range and moves +4 inches on Charge (instead of only +4 and +2).

name: Royal Legion Boost Aura
description: This model and its unit gain Royal Legion Boost.

name: Drakesworn
description: Once per game, immediately after deploying, this unit may move up to 9 inches.

name: Traversal
description: This unit's models may pass through other units, friendly or enemy, while moving.

name: Ethereal
description: Once per activation, before attacking, place each model fully within 6 inches of its position. Moves -6 inches on Advance and on Rush/Charge.

name: Unmovable
description: If this unit is Shaken at the start of the round, roll one die. On a 4+ it stops being Shaken.

name: Vale Oath
description: If this unit is Shaken at the start of the round, roll one die. On a 4+ it stops being Shaken.

name: Steadfast Buff
description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12 inches, which gains Steadfast for its next relevant roll.

name: Great Banner
description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12 inches, which gains Courage for its next relevant roll.

name: Great Musician
description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12 inches, which gains Musician for its next relevant roll.

name: Hold the Line Boost Buff
description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12 inches, which gains Hold the Line Boost for its next relevant roll.

name: Defense Buff
description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12 inches, which gains Entrenched for its next relevant roll.

name: Buccaneer
description: When shooting enemies over 9 inches away, this model gets +1 to hit.

name: Buccaneer Boost
description: If this model has Buccaneer, it always gets +1 to hit when shooting (not only over 9 inches away).

name: Buccaneer Boost Aura
description: This model and its unit gain Buccaneer Boost.

name: Vinci Tech (Piercing)
description: AP(+1) when shooting or charging enemies over 9 inches away, for this activation.

name: Vinci Tech (Precision)
description: +1 to hit when shooting or charging enemies over 9 inches away, for this activation.

name: Vinci Tech
description: When this unit is activated, pick one effect until the end of the activation: when shooting or charging enemies over 9 inches away, it gets either AP(+1) or +1 to hit rolls.

name: Good Fighter
description: +1 to hit rolls in melee.

name: Shadowborn
description: Enemies get -4 inches range when shooting this unit and -2 inches of movement when charging it (each to a minimum of 6 inches).

name: Shadowborn Boost
description: If all models in this unit have Shadowborn, enemies get -8 inches range when shooting it and -4 inches of movement when charging it (instead of only -4 and -2; each to a minimum of 6 inches).

name: Shadowborn Boost Aura
description: This model and its unit gain Shadowborn Boost.

name: Vinci Tech Boost
description: If this model has Vinci Tech, it gets both AP(+1) and +1 to hit rolls when shooting or charging enemies over 9 inches away (no need to pick one).

name: Vinci Tech Boost Aura
description: This model and its unit gain Vinci Tech Boost.

name: Takedown when Shooting
description: When shooting, may fire at a single chosen model in the target unit; all wounds hit that model. Must be resolved before the unit's other weapons.

name: Wild Veil
description: Enemies get -4 inches range when shooting this unit and -2 inches of movement when charging it (each to a minimum of 6 inches).

name: Wild Veil Boost
description: If all models in this unit have Wild Veil, enemies get -8 inches range when shooting it and -4 inches of movement when charging it (instead of only -4 and -2; each to a minimum of 6 inches).

name: Wild Veil Boost Aura
description: This model and its unit gain Wild Veil Boost.

name: Melee Evasion Buff
description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12 inches, which gains Melee Evasion for its next relevant roll.

name: Piercing Assault Buff
description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12 inches, which gains Piercing Assault for its next relevant roll.

name: Rapid Rush Buff
description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12 inches, which gains Rapid Rush for its next relevant roll.

name: Versatile Attack Buff
description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12 inches, which gains Versatile Attack for its next relevant roll.

name: Piercing Fighting Mark
description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18 inches in line of sight. The first friendly attack against it this activation gets AP(+1) in melee.

name: Rapid Charge Mark
description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18 inches in line of sight. The first friendly attack against it this activation gets Rapid Charge.

name: Surge Mark
description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18 inches in line of sight. The first friendly attack against it this activation gets Surge.

name: Precision Feat Boost
description: This unit gets +1 to hit rolls.

name: Precision Feat
description: Once per game, at the start of its activation, this unit may take +1 to hit rolls for that activation.

name: Piercing Feat Boost
description: This unit's weapons get AP(+1).

name: Piercing Feat
description: Once per game, at the start of its activation, this unit may give all its weapons AP(+1) for that activation.

name: Destroyer
description: Each of the defender's unmodified Defense rolls of 1 deals an extra wound.

name: Destroyer Boost
description: If this model has Destroyer and shoots or charges enemies over 9 inches away, the defender's unmodified defense rolls of 1-2 each deal an extra wound (instead of only 1). The base rule already covers the 1s.

name: Destroyer Boost Aura
description: This model and its unit gain Destroyer Boost.

name: Difficult Terrain Debuff
description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18 inches in line of sight, which counts as being in Difficult Terrain once (next time the effect would apply).

name: Fortified Growth
description: Gains a marker at the start of each round while on the table and not Shaken (max 4). If all models have this rule, every two markers reduce attackers' AP by 1 (min AP(0), up to 2).

name: Counter in Melee
description: When charged, this unit strikes first and the charger rolls one fewer Impact die per living model.

name: AP
description: The unit's ranged attacks get AP(1).

name: Melee Slayer
description: When this model charges, its weapons get AP(+2) against units where most models have Tough 3+.

name: Grounded Speed
description: If most models in this unit are within 1 inch of terrain when it activates, it moves +2 inches on Advance and +4 inches on Rush and Charge this activation.

name: Grounded Protection
description: If most models in this unit are within 1 inch of terrain, roll one die for each wound the unit takes. On a 5+ the wound is ignored.

name: Grounded Protection Aura
description: This model and its unit gain Grounded Protection.

name: Vale Oath Boost
description: If this unit has Vale Oath, its roll to stop being Shaken succeeds on a 3+ instead of only on a 4+.

name: Vale Oath Boost Aura
description: This model and its unit gain Vale Oath Boost.

name: Ravage Aura
description: This model and its unit gain Ravage(+1): when it is this unit's turn to attack in melee, it rolls 1 extra Ravage die per model, and each 6+ deals one wound to the target.
